items.text: Today we’re releasing Patch 1.5.1, bringing the Brakes Update along with some fixes for memory leaks.
We know some of you really hated how strong the brakes were, so we decided to take another look at them and see what we could do. Ta-daa! Here they are.

We’ve had a few community testers try out the new brakes, and they gave them a thumbs up. Even Xarrek approved it! They should feel better now and give you more braking distance than before. We hope you’ll like them too and feel the difference, especially when braking and drifting with fastest cars.
Keep in mind that you’ll probably need a few runs to get used to the new braking behavior. Your muscle memory might need a little reset.

We’ve also spent some time looking into one of the biggest issues reported by players - memory leaks. This one was particularly annoying because the reports were quite vague at first, and the actual source of the leaks wasn’t easy to identify. It took us a while, but we finally managed to track down the leaking spots and fix them.
Oh, and one more thing: You can now do a 360° spin with the fastest cars.
Have fun, and let us know how the new brakes feel!
FYI: Today we are releasing this patch only for PC players. Consoles will receive separate patch at different date. Please stay tuned.
New brake.
New handbrake.
Improved drifting.
Fixed memory leaks.
Fixed MacOS not launching issue.

items.text: Today we're releasing the New Physics Update to everyone along with new car - Bento 1995!
We would like to thank our fantastic community for fast feedback on key features.
What’s new in the Physics Update v1.3.8 ?
Smoother, more natural vehicle movement, especially noticeable in the CL class cars.
Improved drifting control, better slide stability and drift duration.
More realistic jumping & landing behavior.
Reduced grip on dirt and asphalt to promote more balanced driving and braking.
Improved Car suspension height to match more realistic fitment.
Improved height in Chase Camera.
Improved Motion Blur.
Optimization across the board. Textures, meshes, collisions, audio sources… little bits everywhere to help with loading and micro-lags.
Fixes to car spring behavior during car collisions. (tires, fences, walls etc.)
Fixes to game Quality Settings to show only POTATO, MEDIUM, ULTRA.
Fixes to disabled Volumetric Lighting on map load.
Added decals to XR wheels.
Added new car Bento.
Wiped Online Leaderboards
FYI: Due to changes in car physics, the online leaderboards have been cleared to give everyone an equal chance in race for the first place in these new road conditions.
We are also adding a totally new car - Bento 1995, available in three classes: CL, RS, and XR. With 6 unique livery designs and 12 color presets, available for in-game $500 each.

items.text: We’re excited to bring you a new update (v.0.6.0.3) that adds tons of content to #DRIVE Rally, including a brand-new map, cars, and features! Here’s what you can expect:

Race through the vibrant streets and diverse landscapes of Rio Guacamole! With 24 regular tracks and 24 reversed tracks, this new map is packed with action—whether you're tearing through the desert, cruising the colorful city streets, or navigating the wild jungle.

Say hello to Juan, your new Co-Pilot from the PepperBoi Racing Team! Leaving behind his mariachi lifestyle, Juan’s here to guide you through every twist and turn on the tracks. With his quick calls and charm, you’ll have the support you need to conquer Rio Guacamole’s toughest challenges. He’s ready to race—are you?

The PepperBoi Team Championships set in Rio Guacamole will put your skills to the test as you team up with Juan and the crew. Starting with the tough and stylish The Ladybug CL, you’ll race across the vibrant desert, city streets, and jungle wilds. Compete in exciting stages, and see if you’ve got what it takes to rise through the ranks with the PepperBoi Team!
Three brand-new cars are making their debut, each with three car classes and over 40 different parts:
The High Five 1981
The Shustryy 1977
The Ladybug 1973
Plus, with 12 color options and 6 patterns for each car, the customization possibilities are almost endless!

Explore maps at your own pace, get familiar with every turn, and discover exciting bonuses like car upgrades or extra in-game cash. Collect all 7 hidden letters scattered across the map to unlock the next location for Free Roam exploration. The available maps for Free Roam now include:
Holzberg
Dry Crumbs
Revontuli
Vinh Vang
Rio Guacamole
To make navigation easier, the Free Roam mode comes equipped with a mini map that helps you find your way.

Each map features 5 hidden addons for your car’s dashboard and mirror. Once unlocked, you can customize your car’s interior in the garage. Each vehicle can be equipped with one dashboard and one mirror addon to personalize your ride.

We heard your feedback and decided to address it, and we’re pleased to announce that you can see your Co-Pilot and Driver sitting inside the car. No more ghostly self-driving cars. From this point on, your Co-Pilot Juan and others will be right there with you.
Behind-Car Camera & Top-Down Camera: You’ll see your Co-Pilot and Driver.
Interior Camera: You’ll see your Co-Pilot, your Driver hands are hidden.

We’ve introduced 8 new achievements tied to the Rio Guacamole Map and Free Roam Mode, offering fresh challenges and rewards for players to unlock. Alongside the new content, we’ve expanded PhotoMode with brand-new stickers—bringing the total to 74 stickers—so you can capture your rally adventures with even more style!

Thank you for your continued support and for playing #DRIVE Rally! We’ve seen some wild leaderboard results and an incredible amount of total playtime. We truly appreciate it all! items.text: Today, we’d like to give you a sneak peek at what’s coming in the December update for #DRIVE Rally.
Since this update will be larger than previous ones, we’ve decided to make it available for early testing via the beta branch feature on Steam (Check below how to switch your game branch).

Please note that this update is still a work in progress, and its features may undergo changes or improvements as part of our development process. Your feedback is always welcome and greatly appreciated!
How to switch branches?

notes.title: To try the Public Beta branch, please follow these steps

items.text: Open Steam
Right-click on #DRIVE Rally in your library
Select Properties
Go to the BETAS tab
Choose "Public Beta" from the "Beta participation" drop-down list
Wait for the game to update the files (if nothing happens, restart the Steam client)
Launch the game
What’s coming in the December update?
Here’s a glimpse of what you can test on the beta branch right now:
Free Roam Mode

Explore maps at your own pace, get familiar with every turn, and discover exciting bonuses like car upgrades or extra in-game cash. Collect all 7 hidden letters scattered across the map to unlock the next location for Free Roam exploration. At the moment you can explore all four maps available in #DRIVE Rally - Holzberg, Dry Crumbs, Revontuli, Vinh Vang.
Free Roam Mini map
To make navigation easier, the Free Roam mode comes equipped with a mini map that helps you find your way.
Car Dashboard and Mirror Addons

Each map features 5 hidden addons for your car’s dashboard and mirror. Once unlocked, you can customize your car’s interior in the garage. Each vehicle can be equipped with one dashboard and one mirror addon to personalize your ride.
Keep in mind that these features are still under development, so some elements may change in the coming weeks. Stay tuned for more updates and let us know what you think of the new content! 🚗💨

Today we’re excited to roll out the #DRIVE Rally update (v0.5.4.2) across all platforms, along with our previous v0.5.3.0 update, bringing in new content and more ways to personalize your rally experience!

Responding to community feedback on pacenotes, we’re enhancing the Co-Pilot reaction system across all four locations. Drivers now have the choice between two pacenote modes – Emotional, Standard and option to turn them off completely. Emotional mode resembles the current setup, with added Co-Pilot comments and reactions based on your driving. Standard mode is a simpler option, providing only the essential pacenotes without any additional shouting or roasting.
"Choose your way!"
"The screenshot you see is from our internal dev tool, which helps us preview pacenote layouts."
New Gameplay Option: Co-Pilot pacenotes - EMOTIONAL, STANDARD and OFF
Updated pacenotes across all four locations. (Holzberg, Dry Crumbs, Revontuli, Vinh Vang)

The latest update, v0.5.4.2, introduces The Doggo 1984, available in three variants: CL, RS, and XR. We’ve also added new features—Car Painting! Car painting will allow you to customize your rally beasts with 6 unique livery designs and 12 color presets per car, available for in-game $500 each.

items.text: New Update for #DRIVE Rally (v0.5.2.1) is live! This update introduces the brand-new car—The Geneve 1975—along with significant improvements to the time penalty system. We’ve also added new features to tackle excessive corner-cutting and incorporated various Quality of Life improvements suggested by the community.
Introduced a slow-down feature that activates when you stray too far off-road.
Added extra safety tire walls to all short rally stages across all maps to prevent corner-cutting.: The remaining tracks will be updated in future patches.
Disabled time penalties for breaking racing objects (tapes, nets, flags, direction signs, tire walls). While you'll still be slowed down when hitting them, no additional penalties will apply.
Disabled time penalty for Car Resetting. Wrecking a car is a punishment in itself.
Added top-down camera option. – now you can experience the race like in the classic #DRIVE game
Gamepad input adjustments for better control.
Tweaked drifting physics for smoother handling.
Fixes to car colliders.
New racing perspective.
With this update, we're excited to introduce the highly requested and anticipated new car! Let's welcome The Geneve 1975 in all its glory!
Please enjoy the game and report any issues! See you on the leaderboards, Drivers!

The next official #DRIVE Rally Patch (v0.5.1.7) is ready! This patch will introduce new feature along with leaderboards saving time issues,
AI Difficulty Settings - From now on you can now choose from three different settings - EASY, MEDIUM, HARD.

Ghosts nameplates - From now on, you'll be able to see the ghost driver's name above their car. The game will randomly choose an opponent based on your current leaderboard time, always selecting someone ahead of you on the leaderboard.
NEW FEATURE: AI Difficulty Settings in Gameplay Options.
Leaderboard times saving and upload fixes.
Fixed issue for occasionally ghosts not showing during the race.
Added driver nameplates to the ghosts, so you know whose time you're trying to beat.

New Demo update is available to download right now. Below is the list of major changes you can expect.

Your #DRIVE just got way smoother! We've tweaked the car physics and braking to make handling more natural and responsive, so from now on you can brake smoothly and drift easier while cutting those sharp corners. Co-pilots reactions were also balanced, we have reduced amount of one-liners that you could hear during the crashes or while passing race checkpoint. Hans should be now more focused on road than his jokes.

Additionally, we have added the ability to edit game Options from the pause gameplay menu, along with few new Options to choose from! Soo from now on you do not have to leave the game every time you want to change something.

We have also added a new function in the form of a Ghost, The Ghost memorizes the Driver's currently best track time and mimics it on the road. This allows you to race against yourself. From now on, when you cover a given rally stage for the first time, you will see your ghost on that route with your best time so far. The Ghost will update every time you beat your Global leaderboard time record. If you don't want to stress about having to set the best time, you can always turn off the Ghost at any time in game Options menu.
What's changed?
Updated Car Physics
Updated Brakes
Fixed Binary Input problems
Pacenotes fixes
Co-driver balance fixes
